title: Explore your city on foot
summary: Step down from the skyline and walk through your neighborhood.
changes: Switch between City view and a new eye-level Street view outside a selected tower.
Walk with WASD or touch controls, drag to look around, and select buildings to meet their residents.
Explore detailed entrances and raised sidewalks, with building and shoreline collision.
Return to your previous City view with Escape or the view switch.
